text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa seemed tired, so I decided 
to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I will get plenty of rest and 
prepare for training!

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The fated final match with the title of 
the world's strongest on the line!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Geh?! What is this, desu?! Pro wrestling?!

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"In the blue corner! Eeeeeeel Condor 
Paaaaasaaaaaa!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm not quite sure what's going on, but if 
I've been summoned, it's only polite to 
show up!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Soaring through the sky towards the world, 
known by all as the Crimson Phantom Bird!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El Condor Pasa has arrivvvvvved!

text_block_list.name: Ring Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, both competitors are ready! Can 
the challenger take down the champion?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Champion or not, El is going all out, 
*desu*!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because waiting at the end of that path is 
the title of the World's Strongest—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...I won! El is the strongest in the 
world...!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Geh?! Huh? Where's El's championship 
belt...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was that just now... a dream?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But that's totally fine! Because El is 
still the world's strongest Umamusume, 
see!

El Condor Pasa seems to have gotten back 
into top form.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—T-That's not fair, having wings is 
totally cheating, y'know... !?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... Where did the champion go?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So it was a dream...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
However... Grrr! To think the champion 
would fly away and escape...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Uuugh... I'm so frustrated-DEEEESU!!

El Condor Pasa was feeling down for a 
while after that...
